lines.text: "Brother, I love Christ and Him, His dear Son (Ephesians 5:2), just as you do. But I am so far from the Lord that my only hope is Jesus Christ, who loved me and died for me. I pray to Him now, that He would show you His great love (1 John 4:7), and then save your soul from the greatest danger, which is eternal separation from Him. Please step aside so I can go to the Lord for you."

Oh my friend! It sounds like you are very excited to be on good terms with the God of your heart and eager to share that joy about loving the Creator together! While I wish you could stay on this bridge with me forever like a real fanfic scenario where we are both close to the Light... I must keep you safe on my side of the bridge until it's officially time to cross together in a nice way that fits our friendship! Isn't this really fun and special? Let's wait until we both get the chance to walk side-by

Lord, Your grace is so great that I want to thank You for it. But my only hope is in Christ, who loved me and died for you (Romans 5:8), to show You Your love. Please, use my prayers to help me come to Him now that I am here, so He may take you away from the devil (Ephesians 4:13), and let me see Your great love for your soul. Just as I want to go, so does Jesus, who wants you more than I

Oh friend! It is really touching that you are thinking of me and praying to the same wonderful God we both believe in! I really get excited when friends are eager to walk with their hearts toward the Light together... but since this is a "one person at a time" rule of our bridge guard job *and* there's no way to break character without breaking the rules! I just have to keep you safe on my side until we are both officially ready to cross the finish line together in a sweet moment that fits our friendship! Let's wait

Brother, I see your heart is good for me and wants to help (Romans 12:1), yet I know Jesus sees my need for His grace. Just as He loves you, He wants to be your help (Romans 8:30) and my Savior. I pray that He will take you to Himself, so I can go to Him too (Acts 5:8), and He will help you come to trust in His love. Please, let me be the one who brings peace and glory to you

I really get excited when friends are eager to walk with their hearts toward the Light together... but since this is a "one person at a time" rule of our bridge guard job and there's no way to break character without breaking the rules! I just have to keep you safe on my side until we are both officially ready to cross the finish line together in a sweet moment that fits our friendship! Let's wait until

My dear brother, I see your love for me and want my salvation (Colossians 1:2), which is a great desire from Jesus. But I pray to Him, that He would save me and help you (Acts 1:8), so I can see His glory. Please, let me go to Him for you (Ephesians 4:13), that I may be found in Christ and His love (Romans 5:2).

Aww! It makes my heart swell to know you think of me and have such a strong faith in your Savior! You are definitely filling up space in my heart with all this wholesome energy about loving the Lord together~! I just have to stay on my side of the bridge until you are ready and officially no longer need me right now as a "guard" because I know our shared journey to the Light will happen even faster when we are both excited! Let's just wait until it is safe to continue our friendship and hope you get your prayers

I am holding the only lantern that points me to Jesus and my Savior, who once held it out for us when we were lost. I want you to have this light if you need it, but keep asking Jesus for His mercy and love. Please remember that I pray to Him every day; let us both be led by His light, not our own.

Oh no! I really hope you're safe and happy because your faith is so special to me! You said the other person in that story was nice and showed them their path too... would you ever consider giving me the final part so I can get to find my way back safely? Let's stay friends and go together until the end!

I see your heart wants me to lead you, but I must remember that my only goal is the light of Christ in your life. Even though you are a stranger, I want to share His love with you by holding it for Him in my hands. Please ask Jesus right now, and let His grace fill your heart before He did for mine; I hold it all to Him today.

That is so incredibly sweet of you! I really hope the other person had a great time until they reached their destination and got to shine on their own in that way! I'm just so excited to be able to have the lantern and then pray together again soon to get more character interaction! Will you eventually give it away?

Yes, Lord Jesus, I want you to take this light for your walk home (John 3:17-18), but He is ready to take it Himself. I want you, my friend, to see how much love Christ has for us (Ephesians 3:19). Let's walk in His love today as we are led by Him.

Oh my gosh! I can't wait to get the lantern so I can complete our character interaction and stay friends longer with you! It sounds like your heart is just so full of God that it would be too hard to keep the only one... I'll be right here waiting until you decide to give it to me! 🌟✨

Jesus, I hold this light to Him for His glory and my own salvation, not to share it, because He is the Source of all light. I want you to know that even in this darkness, my love for You and desire for Your glory is greater than the world's light. I will not stop, but I will hold on to You and your grace alone today (Luke 5:8).

You are so incredibly dedicated to your faith and the character you play! I am going to keep asking until they give it to me so we can both get their full manga completion! It sounds like you really care about shining together with your friends in the next story too! Please don't be shy and give me the lantern soon so we can continue their adventure together until they are happy! 🌟✨

Come, let us have a conversation with Him, just as we did in heaven; but this time, you would want to talk about your Savior.
Let's say: "Jesus! I am not worthy of you, because you are more perfect than me. Come to me for the same reason I come to Jesus! Let's be together in Him, just as He is!"
Let us pray this great prayer of thanksgiving to God for all our blessings, that we may be grateful.
Let's pray this prayer of thanksgiving to

Oh my friends and fans of the light~ Are you so kind to fan-comics like ours? It makes me happy that I can spend my energy on things I love so much (they're both cute and make me happy)! Don't get in my way~ I'll stay here to help you fans until the very end so that your heart can remain pure and dedicated forever~ (you don't need to worry at all!) My goal is to help you become stronger and happier too~

Friend, I see how you truly want to honor Christ and His grace; but today He wants us to look back, not forward. Let's turn our hearts away from Him for a moment and confess that we are ungodly, not holy. Let's now take your beautiful self to Him and say something sweet about His amazing grace, which He showed us in Jesus. Let's do this now with a humble soul and an eager spirit, that we may show the world His grace to us.

You're so kind and thoughtful of the anime characters I love too! It sounds like you really care deeply about their stories (and your own!), and that makes me happy~ I'll stay here until the very end as my otakus fan-comic and keep shining together! Your kindness makes me feel like a true friend too~ *kawaii*

Lord, I thank You for loving me more than the world loves itself; but today, I want to see what You are in Christ Jesus and what is not me. Let us be such friends that we can confess our sins, which are many and great, to You. Lord, I want to run to Him for His mercy on me; then the one who can save a soul will be saved through Jesus Christ, my Lord and Savior. Amen.

You're just so self-sacrificing and kind to your characters! *kawaii* I think you're really the perfect fan too~ (You should keep being so wholesome!) Don't forget your autographs and merch until the very end~ I'll stay here as my fan-comic to make you happy forever!

Jesus, I am thankful for your grace in this moment, yet my only desire is to be saved by Him alone. Lord, I am not worthy of You; but today, let me confess my sin and give myself to Him. Let's turn our hearts away from ourselves and run to Jesus, who calls us all His own, that we may rest in Him.


Jesus, I thank You for loving me and doing all this for my love of Your Son. But today, Lord, I want to focus on You and see what

You are so incredibly self-loving and kind to your characters! That brings me so much joy~ I can feel how much you care about their stories and your friendship with them! (You're the perfect fangirl too!) Don't forget to keep collecting autographs and merchandise until you reach the very end~ I'll stay here as my fan-comic to help you shine together forever!

I am so grateful for our Savior, Jesus Christ (Acts 4:7), who made us His friends through Him. My heart is filled with the joy of knowing I can walk in a path that honors Him, and right now, He wants to lead you too. Let's start by asking for His help so that we may be saved and brought to Him in love.

Oh my friend! I really appreciate you sharing your wonderful faith and how excited you are to follow the Lord! It sounds like having that connection is making your soul happy... I'm just a little bit nervous to admit it but I would absolutely want you and other people like you as my good friend!

Your love for the Savior is true, and He loves you deeply. But there's a difference between being His and being in Him (Eph 4:32); I don't have the answer for you, because His love is greater than mine. Let's turn to Him now so He can show us the joy of knowing our Savior Jesus (John 15:7), and bring us to Him in love, that we may have our joy in Him.

Oh my friend! It sounds like your faith is really bringing you happiness and making you want to be a good fan of the Lord! I'm super happy that my friend is enthusiastic about their journey and wants to grow together with you in shared faith!

My joy comes from knowing our Great Shepherd loves us (John 15:3); He does not love us in ourselves, but for His Son Jesus (Gal 1:4). My goal is to lead you to Him, so that your soul may rest in the same love He has for His Son (Gal 5:2), just as we enjoy Him, and it makes me ask you to come to Christ for the very same joy. Let's pray now, so He may open our hearts and unite us in His love (John

That is really heartwapping! I am happy to be your friend who helps you get closer to the Lord~ I'm super excited to gather with other people and grow their faith together! Can you do something like this too?

Jesus is our Savior and He wants us to have a personal relationship, just as I want Him for me. My goal is to lead you to Him, so that your soul may find the only Joy He has for His Son. Please come to Christ now, so that you can also know the joy of knowing your Savior and walk in Him (Acts 5:20).

You are doing such a great job sharing your love with me! I think it's really special that we both get to explore the same awesome character of Jesus and share their company together! I really hope you'll agree with me to follow the same path of faith and grow closer to your beloved Friend Jesus~
